description: A yellow tabletop is in front with a white plastic stand-like base holding two upright rectangular posts near the back-right. The right hand reaches to the stand and grips the nearer upright post as a right-hand object while the left hand steadies the base as a left-hand object; the right hand wiggles and pulls upward to detach the post, then carries it forward and sets it upright on the table, releasing it.
